articles.title: Chasing 100x tokens is game of ‘irrational exuberance,’ says Polymarket CEO
articles.snippet: Some traders are looking for more predictable prediction market opportunities, rather than playing “hot potato” with the next 100x gem, according to Polymarket’s Shayne Coplan.

articles.title: Russia’s digital ruble accounts top 220K in first month, nearly 4X central bank forecast
articles.snippet: The digital ruble’s early uptake comes as BRICS nations explore linking their digital currencies for cross-border trade and payments.

articles.title: Google Lets You Build a Video Game by Typing a Description
articles.snippet: Google's Playground turns a typed description into a playable, shareable game, no coding required. It's live for U.S. adults, with creation access tiered by Google AI subscription.

articles.title: Someone Scraped 5.6 Billion TikTok Videos and Put the Data on Hugging Face for Free
articles.snippet: A developer posted metadata for about 5.6 billion public TikTok videos, scraped through the app's private API in a way TikTok's terms prohibit. The free dataset also doubles as a storefront.
